title: Interparfums Q3 sales surge of 4.8% triggers stock price jump
summary: The fragrance company, which makes scents for Jimmy Choo, Coach, Lacoste and DKNY, saw stock prices rise on 20 October after its Q3 2026 financial report signalled a strong market performance

extraction.key_fact: Interparfums가 3분기 실적 발표 뒤 주가가 올랐다.
